CLINICAL DATA: 
Right breast cancer, stitch on axillary tail. 
 
 
FINAL DIAGNOSIS: 
BREAST (RIGHT), MODIFIED RADICAL MASTECTOMY: 
1. INVASIVE APOCRINE CARCINOMA WITH MARKED DERMAL INVOLVEMENT, SEE NOTE AND 
TALE #1. 
2. DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN-SITU, APOCRINE TYPE. 
3. ATYPICAL APOCRINE ADENOSIS. 
4. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF MALIGNANCY IN 16 AXILLARY LYMPH NODES (0/16), SEE 
NOTE. 
 
NOTE: The residual invasive carcinoma is present within an extensive 
background of histiocytic and lymphocytic inflammation, consistent with 
treatment effect. Additionally most of the remaining viable carcinoma cells 
display degenerative cytological features. Several lymph nodes demonstrate 
areas of fibrosis and histiocytic replacement, consistent with resolved tumor. 
 
TABLE OF PATHOLOGICAL FINDINGS # 1 
INVASIVE CARCINOMA 
 
TUMOR SIZE: Spanning at least 1.6cm  A separate <0.1cm focus is also 
present. 
GRADE: 3.

greater.

GRADE OF DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN-SITU: 3. 
MARGIN OF DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN-SITU: The distances to all margins measure 0.2cm 
or greater.
